page.layout: One page of running text. Above the text, three woodcut coins with legends in the images. Below the text, a decorative ornament. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. No margin notes.

main_text.l: JUDAS Iscariotes unus ex duodecim Apostolis Domini
fuit,qui cum loculos gestaret,fur & auarus erat : nec æquo po-
tuit animo pati unguenti pretiosi effusionem in corpus Christi.
Hic Dominum suum,ac nostrum, pretio triginta denariorum
prodidit, signo osculi dato Judæis ut Christum cognoscerent.
tandem pœnituit,& pecuniâ retulit,ex qua emptus est ager fi-
guli in sepulturam peregrinorū: veruntamen amens & exspes
laqueo se suspendit,mediúsque crepuit, & diffusa sunt omnia
viscera eius,cùm desperaret de obtinenda venia à piisimo ac,
ut ita dicam,misericordissimo Deo,ac in Judæ locum subroga-
tus est Mathias.Porrò quod attinet ad rationem denariorum,
singuli valebát tres asses,siue solidos, & dimidium (autore Bu-
dæo in libro de Asse) si quidem erant denarij Romani ac vul-
gares:cuiuscunque autem formæ aut metalli fuerint, feruntur

page.notes: The three coins are woodcuts; the first bears the legend "IVDAS · SCARIOTH" with Greek letters around the rim, the second "POAION" (Greek), and the third's legend is not legible enough to transcribe. The ornament below the text is decorative and not transcribed. The running head "PROMPTV. ICONVM" was read as "PROMPTU. ICONUM" under the u/v rule. Greek on the coins is not reproduced here.
